body: Clash D. Finding 7: the battery has charge and health; burnout is charge at zero. Inversion Log entry 51 moved from depletion to effort-as-cost (the 'willpower runs out' model has not held up in large replications). Read back as the option 'Keep it, tag as metaphor: charge stays as your felt label; the tank model is marked as metaphor, not mechanism.' JayArr chose it, 2026-10-11.
plain: 'Charge' stays as his felt label for daily energy; the tank-that-empties model is tagged as metaphor, not mechanism. Battery health as allostatic load stands.
